page.layout: Printed page with a running head and page number at top. Below the head, a centred emblem title in two lines. Then a full-width engraving. Below it, four centred lines of italic verse. At the lower right, one word set flush right.

l.i: Altius ecce Aquila hæc auibus volat omnibus, istum
Subuolat alma fides sydera ad usq; modum.
Nec secus Æstræum librat se ad inania iustum,

page.notes: Engraving between the title and the verse: an eagle with spread wings, flying above a rock with a castle on top, with a sun with a face at upper left and a landscape with hills at the base. No printed text in the picture. The word "Scripturæ" at lower right is set apart from the verse and is treated here as a catchword; it may be a citation label. Verse spelling follows the scan: long s written as s, and u/v and i/j normalised.
